Polysomnography Report
Date: 03/02/2026
Patient: Goldie Bernhard, 74 y/o F

Attended PSG 03/02/2026.

Sleep architecture: REM 18%, N3 22%, sleep efficiency 85%.
Respiratory events: AHI 30.2/h. CA+MA 5% of total AHI.
Oxygen desaturation nadir 88%, mean SpO2 94%.

Periodic limb movements index 12/h.

Impression: Moderate OSA with predominantly obstructive events, minimal central/mixed component.

Recommendations: CPAP titration advised.

Sleep Medicine Consultation
Date: 08/02/2026
Patient: Goldie Bernhard, 74 y/o F

Hx: Pt referred for eval of persistent sleep issues despite CPAP.

Current Tx: CPAP 10 cmH2O, residual AHI 28.1 despite nightly use = failure.

Assessment: Continued elevated AHI indicates inadequate control of OSA with current CPAP settings.

Plan: Consider alternative therapies including BiPAP or advanced PAP modalities. Recommend repeat sleep study to reassess severity and titrate treatment. Discuss adjunctive options such as positional therapy or oral appliance if indicated.

Follow-up scheduled in 4 weeks to review results and adjust management accordingly.
